A '''skirmish''' occurred in a [[Cavamina Minor cantina|cantina]] on [[Cavamina Minor]] around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] arrived at the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] with an escort of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in search of the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Attuma Duum]], but they were attacked by several operatives in Duum's employ. Secura was the only survivor of the ensuing [[lightfight]].
